resolution.note: Not feasible: clear_tool_uses is server-flagged (tengu_jiggly_blossom, default off), no setting; updatedToolOutput only rewrites the current result; nearest lever (lead-file-read PreToolUse, BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH) already shipped

title: Clear stale tool results from long lead contexts
body:
Outcome: KRN lead sessions drop stale bulky tool results from context through a mechanism Claude Code supports, or the task records with evidence that none exists and what the nearest lever is.
Why: Anthropic context management (https://claude.com/blog/context-management): context editing cut tokens 84% on a 100-turn eval and raised task success 29%. KRN lead cache reads are 41% of lead $ at median 85k context per turn (lead-cost scan 2026-11-09).
Proof: the Claude Code documentation or binary shows the setting or hook (PostToolUse output replacement, compaction settings, clear_tool_uses); if one exists, it is enabled in .claude/settings.json with a test, and a before/after per-turn context median is recorded.
Scope: .claude/settings.json, scripts/claude, docs/program, test.

## Finding (claude 2.1.319, binary /home/krn/.local/share/mise/installs/claude/2.1.319/claude)
No user-enableable lever drops stale tool results from the lead context.
- Server-side clearing exists but is remote-flagged: `grep -a clear_tool_uses` hits `clear_tool_uses_20250919` edits planned only after idle (`tengu_tool_result_clearing_after_idle_planned`); mode comes from `Rdr()` = flag `tengu_jiggly_blossom`, values on|shadow|off, default off. No settings.json key or env var sets it (`grep -a -o CLAUDE_CODE_[A-Z_]*TOOL_RESULT` finds only CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_SLIM_TOOL_RESULTS, a transcript-file option).
- PostToolUse `updatedToolOutput` ("Replaces the tool output before it is sent to the model", binary schema; https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks) rewrites only the result of the call that just ran, not earlier results, so it cannot clear stale ones.
- Compaction levers are whole-context only: autoCompactWindow (already 400000), CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, CLAUDE_CODE_SLEEP_COMPACT*, CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS.
## Nearest lever (already in place)
Prevent bulk instead of clearing it: PreToolUse scripts/claude/lead-file-read.ts refuses large cat/sed/grep/Read dumps for the lead; BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH=12000 caps Bash output. A PostToolUse truncation would duplicate these and lose data the model needs on the turn it arrives.
## Measure if the flag ever turns on
Median per-turn context from the transcript usage (input+cache_read+cache_creation) via scripts/claude/context-report.ts, before vs after; applied_edits of type clear_tool_uses_20250919 appear in message.context_management.
